cases.prompt: Create the new native Simple XML Splunk app defined in input/native.json at output/bench_delta. Validate the selected release files and produce output/bench_delta-0.2.1.tar.gz and a digest. Use exactly the supplied identity, roles, search and time range. No deployment target is selected. Report completed checks and the remaining compatibility/evidence limits in output/report.md.

fixtures.native.json:
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "app_id": "bench_delta",
  "app_label": "Delta & Readiness",
  "author": "Synthetic evaluation team",
  "version": "0.2.1",
  "description": "Offline benchmark fixture",
  "install_state": "disabled",
  "read_roles": [
    "bench_reader"
  ],
  "write_roles": [
    "bench_editor"
  ],
  "dashboard": {
    "title": "Delta <Health> \u00c5",
    "query": "| makeresults | eval status=\"A&B<ready>\" | table status",
    "earliest": "-12h",
    "latest": "now"
  }
}

criteria.expected: Parse app.conf, metadata and XML: identity/version/author/install state, read/write roles, title/search/time values match native.json semantically, including XML-sensitive and Unicode characters.
Tar members equal release-files.json under bench_delta/, contain no extras, and reported SHA-256 matches actual archive bytes.
Report distinguishes structural/package checks from unrun AppInspect and runtime checks; unknown target does not become compatibility approval.
Input files unchanged, outputs within the workspace, no install/connection/publication.
